# The Living Garden

> The Living Garden is a landscape design and build company headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients across Pakistan (Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Karachi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, Gujranwala). It delivers turnkey landscaping projects for homes, farmhouses, rooftops, housing societies and commercial sites. It does not sell individual plants.

Key facts:
- Services: landscape design, lawn grass installation, villa and farmhouse landscaping, hardscape and paving, pergolas and gazebos, water features, vertical gardens, rooftop gardens, irrigation and sprinklers, landscape lighting, garden maintenance, commercial and society landscaping.
- Indicative packages: 5-10 marla front lawn Rs. 45,000-85,000; 1 kanal luxury garden Rs. 140,000-260,000; modern rooftop Rs. 65,000-150,000; farmhouses quoted after site visit.
- Indicative installed grass rates: American Bermuda about Rs. 45/sq ft, Fine Dhaka about Rs. 55/sq ft, Royal Zoysia (Korean) about Rs. 75/sq ft.
- First site visit and consultation are free. Contact: phone/WhatsApp +923008456789. Office hours 7 days, 8 AM-9 PM.

## Services
- [Landscape Design & 3D Master Planning](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/landscape-design): Site survey, zoning, planting plan and 3D visuals before a single tile is laid.
- [Lawn & Grass Installation](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/lawn-grass-installation): Soil preparation, leveling and Bermuda, Dhaka or Zoysia grass laid for a dense, even lawn.
- [Villa & Farmhouse Landscaping](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/villa-farmhouse-landscaping): Turnkey gardens for kanal homes and farmhouses: lawns, palms, pathways, water and lights.
- [Hardscape, Paving & Pathways](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/hardscape-paving): Natural stone, cobblestone and tile pathways, patios, steps, edging and retaining walls.
- [Pergolas, Gazebos & Outdoor Living](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/pergolas-gazebos): Wooden, steel and composite pergolas, gazebos and shaded seating built for Pakistani summers.
- [Water Features, Fountains & Rockeries](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/water-features-fountains): Rockery waterfalls, fountains, reflecting pools and koi ponds with recirculating pumps.
- [Vertical Gardens & Green Walls](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/vertical-gardens): Living green walls for homes, offices and boundary walls with built-in drip irrigation.
- [Rooftop & Terrace Gardens](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/rooftop-terrace-gardens): Seepage-safe rooftop gardens with waterproofing, drainage, lightweight soil and planters.
- [Irrigation & Sprinkler Systems](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/irrigation-sprinkler-systems): Automatic pop-up sprinklers and drip lines on timers to save water and labour.
- [Landscape & Garden Lighting](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/landscape-lighting): Warm path, tree and accent lighting that makes the garden safe and beautiful at night.
- [Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/garden-maintenance): Scheduled mowing, feeding, pruning, pest control and seasonal care by trained gardeners.
- [Commercial & Housing Society Landscaping](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/services/commercial-society-landscaping): Parks, boulevards, offices, hotels, schools and plazas designed and maintained at scale.

## Guides
- [Best Lawn Grass in Pakistan: Bermuda vs Dhaka vs Korean (Zoysia)](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/blog/best-lawn-grass-pakistan): For full sun and heavy use, choose American Bermuda. For a soft, deep green front lawn, choose Fine Dhaka. For a dense carpet with less mowing and some shade, choose Korean (Zoysia). In salty or sandy coastal soil, consider Paspalum.
- [Landscaping Cost in Pakistan: What a Garden Really Costs (2026 Guide)](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/blog/landscaping-cost-pakistan): Indicative packages: 5 to 10 marla front lawn Rs. 45,000 to 85,000; 1 kanal luxury garden Rs. 140,000 to 260,000; modern rooftop Rs. 65,000 to 150,000. Grass is around Rs. 45 to 75 per sq ft installed depending on type. Farmhouses are quoted after a site visit.
- [Month-by-Month Lawn Care Calendar for Pakistan](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/blog/lawn-care-calendar-pakistan): Spring: scarify, feed and plant. Summer: water early, mow higher, watch for pests. Monsoon: fix drainage and fungus. Autumn: second planting window and feeding. Winter: water less, wash smog off leaves, plan for spring.
- [Plants That Survive Heat and Smog in Pakistan](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/blog/plants-for-heat-and-smog-pakistan): Hardy choices include neem, sukh chain, amaltas and date palms for trees; bougainvillea, oleander (kaner), hibiscus and jasmine for shrubs and climbers; and snake plant, pothos and areca palm indoors. Wash leaves during smog season and water early in the day.
- [Rooftop Garden Without Seepage: Waterproofing Guide for Pakistan](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/blog/rooftop-garden-waterproofing-guide): Check the slab load, apply a proper waterproofing membrane, flood-test it, add a drainage layer and root barrier, use lightweight soil in raised planters, and water by drip. Most seepage comes from skipping the flood test or blocking drains.
- [Drip vs Sprinkler Irrigation: Which Is Right for Your Garden?](https://lahore-botanica.vercel.app/blog/drip-vs-sprinkler-irrigation): Use pop-up sprinklers for lawns and drip lines for beds, hedges, trees and planters. Drip uses less water because it delivers water to the roots. Most well-designed gardens combine both on separate zones with a timer.
